purpose: Four-task dry run of the Quality-0 arms: proves the harness can run all arms fairly, that budget guards hold, and that the scoring sheet can be filled - not a ranking.
notes: A task with a follow_up counts as two user rounds.
The chatgpt arm is run by a human and never sends an API request through this harness.
Exceeding max_model_sends or max_cost_cny must abort before the first send.
